title: Living Alone (A Fantastic Tale of War and Magic)
author: Stella Benson
description:
When a mysterious letter arrives, revealing a hidden world just beyond the ordinary, the life of a reclusive artist changes forever. In *Living Alone*, Stella Benson invites listeners on a whimsical journey through London during the tumult of the First World War. Our protagonist, adrift in the chaos of a city under siege, grapples with the haunting reality of solitude while yearning for connection and inspiration.

As she delves into the eccentricities of her neighbors and the peculiar happenings around her, our artist uncovers a vibrant tapestry of fantastical elements that challenge her perceptions of reality. The story intertwines the mundane with the magical, exploring themes of isolation, creativity, and the search for belonging.

With each turn of the page, listeners will find themselves captivated by the enchanting characters and the surreal events that unfold. Will the artist embrace the strange wonders that beckon her, or will she retreat further into the shadows of her own making?

*Living Alone* is not just a tale of one woman's journey but an exploration of the delicate balance between reality and imagination. Perfect for fans of fantastic fiction, this audiobook promises to spark curiosity and ignite the imagination, leaving listeners eager to discover what lies beyond the veil of the everyday. Join us in this charming adventure that reminds us of the beauty of connection, even in the most unexpected places.

title: 72 years with a Sasquatch named Winter
author: Leslie Garcia
description:
72 Years with Winter – An Extraordinary FriendshipDeep in the beautiful wilderness of British Columbia, Canada, a chance encounter between a young girl named Madeline and a juvenile female Sasquatch she would eventually name Winter becomes the beginning of an extraordinary friendship spanning 72 years.

Follow Madeline as she grows from a curious young girl into a wife, mother and grandmother, all while maintaining a remarkable bond with a creature most people refuse to believe exists. Through the decades, their lives become intertwined as they share moments of joy, heartbreak, adventure, danger and devastating loss. Madeline is gradually welcomed into Winter's secretive world, where she discovers the complexities of Sasquatch family life, their customs, their struggles and their remarkable capacity for love and loyalty.

But their friendship doesn't come without consequences. Both must navigate the dangers of two very different worlds, where fear, prejudice and mistrust threaten everything they have come to cherish.

Originally narrated on the Cryptids Canada YouTube channel, 72 Years with Winter is an ongoing, chapter-by-chapter story that has captured the hearts of listeners around the world. Whether you're a believer in Sasquatch or simply someone who appreciates a darn good s

tory, come along on this unforgettable journey of friendship, family, courage and unconditional love.For the best listening experience, please start with Part One and follow the series in chronological order.

description: 300 years ago Immanuel Kant was born - and I want to dedicate an extensive series of lectures to his whole philosophy. I spent the past year studying the 29 volumes of Kant's collected works and reading at least a 100 pages of Kant every day, in order to now provide the probably most comprehensive and most thorough presentation on his philosophy which has been attempted so far, to show its inner systematic relations and, most of all, to identify Kant's contribution to the aufklärung of humanity.

From connectivity, workload and wellbeing to safety, decision-making, training and seafarer-centred design, the conversations explore what works, what needs to change and how the industry can make better use of technology by listening to the people who work with it every day.

As part of the STEER Project, supported by Lloyd’s Register Foundation, the series puts seafarers’ experiences and perspectives at the centre of the conversation, sharing insights and exploring how technology can support safer, more effective and more sustainable maritime operations.

title: Health & Longevity with Dr. G
author: Dominic
description:
Welcome to the official Podcast channel of Dr. G.


I'm Dr. Dominic Gaziano, a primary care physician with over 25 years of experience helping patients understand their health, prevent disease, and make informed medical decisions.


After decades of working with patients, I've learned that some of the most serious health problems develop long before you notice any symptoms.

High blood pressure, heart disease, diabetes, and other chronic conditions can quietly affect your health for years.


On this podcast, I break down the medical information you need to know in straightforward, easy-to-understand language.


We'll cover:

  • Heart health and cardiovascular disease prevention
  • High blood pressure and cholesterol
  • Diabetes and blood sugar management
  • Preventive medicine and early detection
  • Healthy aging and longevity
  • Medical tests, treatments, and medications
  • Common health mistakes and what to do instead


My goal is to help you understand what's happening inside your body, recognize potential health risks, and ask better questions when you visit your doctor.


No confusing medical jargon. Just practical health information backed by medical science and decades of clinical experience.


Follow for videos to help you take a more active role in your health.


Disclaimer: This channel is for educational purposes only and does not replace personalized medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment from your healthcare professional.

title: Living with CIDP
author: Speakeasy Studios
description:
Living with CIDP is the podcast that gives a voice to a disease most people have never heard of, and the people learning to live with it anyway.

Hosted by John Rubio, a musician and CIDP patient who's spent years navigating misdiagnoses, remission, relapse, and a healthcare system that doesn't always make it easy to get better, this show pulls back the curtain on what it's really like to live with a rare autoimmune condition.

Each episode brings on patients, caregivers, and voices from inside the medical and insurance systems to talk honestly about diagnosis, treatment, the fight for proper care, and the mindset it takes to keep going when the body won't cooperate. This isn't a clinical show, and it's not about sympathy. It's about the real, unfiltered experience of living with a chronic illness and refusing to be defined by it.

Ready to hear the stories no one else is telling? Welcome to Living with CIDP.

No science experiments and no hype, just decision-grade intelligence from practitioners who’ve run these systems themselves. New episodes every Monday.

Hosted by Bernadette Wesley, this podcast lives in that meeting place, questioning the myth of separation and exploring what becomes possible when we live from interconnection. It's for people who sense the old ways of seeing no longer fit. What does it mean to be both the river and the sea?

Season 1: Organizations That Discern
In this experimental, dialogue-driven series, Bernadette and Ted Rau ask: What if the next stage of organizational development isn't managing complexity better, but learning to consciously participate in a living, creative intelligence that is continuously generating reality? And what practices, structures, and inner capacities would organizations need to cultivate to do that?

title: Cripping Culture Oral Histories
author: Disability Arts Online
description:
Cripping Culture Oral Histories explores the history of the Disability Arts movement through the memories of the disabled artists and activists who shaped it. The series shares achievements, brings previously hidden stories to light and offers new perspectives on key moments in the movement’s history and its role in advancing disability rights from the late 1970s onwards.

Cripping, like queering, uses a reclaimed word to apply a disability lens to culture.

This podcast is part of Cripping Culture: A Journey into Disability Arts Heritage. We are grateful to The National Lottery Heritage Fund and National Lottery players for supporting this project.

title: Notes on Nursing (The Foundations of Modern Healthcare)
author: Florence Nightingale
description:
In 1859, Florence Nightingale boldly challenged the status quo of healthcare with her groundbreaking insights in *Notes on Nursing*. As the pioneer of modern nursing, Nightingale exposes the often-overlooked aspects of patient care that extend far beyond the mere administration of medicine. This audiobook invites listeners into her revolutionary approach, which emphasizes hygiene, nutrition, and the emotional well-being of patients, all while advocating for systemic changes in healthcare.

Listeners will witness Nightingale’s passionate commitment to improving the lives of the sick and infirm, learning how she transformed nursing into a respected profession. Through vivid anecdotes and practical advice, she confronts the challenges of her time, from unsanitary conditions in hospitals to the need for compassionate care. Her work is not just a historical document; it serves as a timeless guide that remains relevant today for healthcare professionals, caregivers, and anyone interested in the art of healing.

What drives Nightingale to become the 'Lady with the Lamp'? How do her principles apply to contemporary nursing and public health? Dive into this rich exploration and discover the enduring legacy of a woman who changed the face of healthcare forever. With each chapter, you’ll gain new insights into the heart of nursing and the vital importance of holistic patient care. Experience the journey of a true pioneer and understand why her notes are essential listening for anyone who cares about health and healing.

title: RetailTalk
author: Omni Talk Retail
description:
The CEO chair is the loneliest seat in retail. RetailTalk pulls up a chair right next to it.
Every episode, Chris Walton, co-founder of Omni Talk, Forbes contributor, and former Target VP, sits down with one C-suite retail executive for a long, unhurried conversation about how they really lead. Only C-suite guests: CEOs, presidents, COOs, and the people who make the calls that show up on store shelves, in earnings reports, and in the lives of hundreds of thousands of employees.
Think Inside the Actor's Studio meets a Shoptalk keynote. Chris has been where his guests are: in the boardroom, in the stores, and in the hard meetings. So he skips the stock "tell us about your journey" questions and asks what other executives actually want to know:
- How do you decide what not to do?
- What did you get wrong, and what did it teach you?
- How do you read a store, a P&L, or a team in the first five minutes?
- Where is the industry fooling itself right now?
- What does a great operator know that a great strategist misses?
What you won't get: press-release talking points, hype, or another round of AI buzzwords. Chris has spent more than eight years and 2,000+ episodes cutting through retail noise on Omni Talk, and RetailTalk holds its guests to the same standard. The conversations stay on the record and on point, and they're honest about the trade-offs behind every big decision.
WHY LISTEN
If you lead in retail, or want to someday, this is the closest you'll get to a private hour with the people running the industry's biggest companies. title: US Military Ranks and Inisgnias
author: Pashto Domaining
description:
Podcast Topic: Understanding US Military Ranks and InsigniaCreate an engaging, professional podcast episode about the United States military ranking system.Episode Title: US Military Ranks Explained: Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Space Force and Coast GuardTarget Audience: US military enthusiasts, students, military career applicants, veterans, researchers and people interested in military history.Episode Structure:
  1. Introduction
    • Explain why military ranks are important.
    • Introduce the six branches of the US Armed Forces.
  2. US Army Ranks
    • Explain enlisted ranks from Private to Sergeant Major of the Army.
    • Explain warrant officer ranks.
    • Explain commissioned officer ranks from Second Lieutenant to General.
    • Discuss rank insignia and responsibilities.
  3. US Navy Ranks
    • Explain enlisted ratings and pay grades.
    • Cover Chief Petty Officers.
    • Explain commissioned officer ranks from Ensign to Admiral.
    • Discuss Navy rank insignia.
  4. US Air Force Ranks
    • Explain Airman ranks, Non-Commissioned Officers and Senior NCOs.
    • Cover officer ranks from Second Lieutenant to General.
    • Explain rank insignia.
  5. US Marine Corps Ranks
    • Explain enlisted, NCO and Staff NCO ranks.
    • Discuss warrant officers and commissioned officers.
    • Explain Marine Corps insignia.
  6. US Space Force Ranks
    • Explain enlisted Guardians, Non-Commissioned Officers and Senior NCOs.
    • Cover officer ranks.
    • Discuss Space Force rank insignia and its distinctive features.
  7. US Coast Guard Ranks
    • Explain enlisted, warrant officer and commissioned officer ranks.
    • Discuss the Coast Guard's ranking structure.
  8. Comparison
    • Compare equivalent pay grades across all six branches.
    • Explain why the same pay grade can have different rank titles.
    • Clarify that equivalent pay grades do not necessarily mean identical authority or responsibilities.
  9. Interesting Facts
    • Explain the highest-ranking positions.
    • Discuss the difference between enlisted personnel and commissioned officers.
    • Explain how promotions work.
  10. Conclusion
  • Summarize the US military ranking system.
  • Encourage listeners to explore detailed rank charts and insignia guides.
Presentation Style:
  • Use two professional podcast hosts having a natural conversation.
  • Make the discussion educational, engaging and easy to understand.
  • Include real-world examples.
  • Avoid unnecessarily complicated military terminology.
  • Explain every rank in its correct hierarchical order.
  • Do not invent ranks, insignia or promotion requirements.
  • Verify rank structures against official US military sources.
  • Clearly distinguish between pay grades, rank titles and positions.
Website Mention:Naturally mention ForcesGuide.com as an online resource for exploring military ranks, insignia and armed forces structures around the world.Ending:
Finish with a memorable summary explaining why understanding military ranks helps people better understand the organization and leadership of the US Armed Forces.

title: Worth Fighting For
author: Demetrius Williams
description: Life is hard. Chasing your dreams is hard. Becoming the person you know you're capable of being is hard. But that doesn't mean it's not worth fighting for.  Hosted by Demetrius Williams, *Worth Fighting For* is a real-time documentation of my journey to build the life I've always envisioned for myself.  I'm documenting the wins, the losses, the sacrifices, the breakthroughs, the difficult decisions, and everything in between. Not from the perspective of someone looking back after achieving success, but from someone actively pursuing it.  By following my journey, you'll get:  - An unfiltered look at what pursuing your dreams actually requires, beyond the highlight reels and success stories. - Hard-earned lessons you can apply to your own ambitions without having to make the same mistakes. - Different perspectives on the challenges, fears, and uncertainties you're experiencing in your own life. - Exposure to the thought processes, decisions, and strategies I use to navigate obstacles and move forward. - A reminder that struggling, questioning yourself, and experiencing setbacks are all part of pursuing something meaningful.  I don't have all the answers, and I won't pretend to. I'm figuring things out, challenging my own beliefs, making mistakes, and growing along the way.  I'm simply documenting the process in hopes that something I experience, discover, or overcome helps you along your own journey.  Because no matter where you are in your journey, the life you envision for yourself is ALWAYS worth fighting for.

title: To Finish the Course by Ardyce Miller-Templeman
author: Momentum Media Advertising
description: Walk the walls of Jerusalem beside two Roman soldiers, Marcos and Gaius, and watch history's most unlikely revolution unfold before their eyes. Across eight episodes, we trace Ardyce Miller-Templeman's *To Finish the Course* from Saul's persecutions to Paul's perilous journeys through the Caesars' empire, until the question every character faces becomes yours: what is the truth worth to you? You'll come away seeing the early church not as a distant story but as a living, costly, deeply human fight for the good news.  By the final episode, you'll understand how Roman law and the reigns of the Caesars, from Tiberius through Nero, shaped the world the fledgling church had to survive in. You'll gain a clear picture of Paul's travels and the hardships he endured, including stonings, floggings, imprisonment, and three shipwrecks, and see how he defended his message and calling through every one. You'll learn to read the story through an outsider's eyes, noticing how observation can move to belief, as it does for the two soldiers. And you'll carry away a sharper grasp of the book's central claim: that Christ came to establish His kingdom in human hearts, and that believers were willing to give everything for it.  This season is made for listeners and readers who love historical fiction, biblical history, or simply a story with real stakes. Perhaps you've read Paul's letters a hundred times and wondered what he looked like to the people watching him. Perhaps you're curious how faith appeared to skeptical outsiders. If so, pull up a place on the wall with us; this one was made for you.

title: Out of Order: The Firing Order Coaching Show
author: Brian Hunnicutt
description:
When a shop isn't performing, most owners push harder on the numbers: more cars, more marketing, more pressure. But results are the last thing to change. Something upstream is out of order.

Out of Order is the Firing Order Coaching Podcast, hosted by leadership coach, author and speaker Brian Hunnicutt. With nearly fifty years in the automotive industry and nineteen years of coaching, Brian works with independent auto repair shop owners, service advisors, technicians and leaders who are tired of feeling stuck.

Every week, Brian takes one problem shop owners live with: the technician they can't find, the month that was busy but broke, the shop that can't run a day without them, the phone call that should have been a customer. He finds what's really out of order and puts it back in the right order, live, with shop owners he coaches.

The framework is simple: People. Process. Performance. In the right order. Inside every person runs another order: values, emotion, Command Energy, behavior, identity and results. When that order is right, identity develops Command Intelligence, which turns identity into leadership. Leadership builds culture, commitment, engagement, performance and long-term success.

No hype. No pressure tactics. Just clear thinking, the hard truth, and one specific action you can take this week, for your team and for the customers who trust you with their vehicles.

title: Liberated

description:
What does it mean to have lived through the Holocaust — and to carry its memories for a lifetime? For some, survival meant hiding in silence, separated from family and the world outside. For others, it meant escaping Nazi persecution only to face closed borders and an uncertain future. And for many, liberation was not the end of their story, but the beginning of a lifetime of remembering, rebuilding and bearing witness.


Liberated is a powerful storytelling podcast that shares extraordinary accounts of the Holocaust told from the point of view of those who lived through it. Hosted by award-winning documentary producer Jason Charters, each episode features intimate, first-person testimony with stories of resistance, loss, courage, exile, reinvention and hope.


This isn’t a textbook. It’s lived experience. Survivors share what it felt like to be young during Nazi persecution, how trauma shaped their futures and why their stories still matter in a world grappling with intolerance, forced migration, closed borders and rising nationalism. Perfect for students, educators, and anyone who loves immersive narrative history storytelling.


Liberated is a joint production of The Azrieli Foundation’s Holocaust Survivor Memoir Project and Riddle Films.

You talk to your dog or cat and half-know they understand you.

I'm Fran Patel. Every other week I sit down with pet mums for honest conversations.

Across five seasons, we explore the objects of the table, the pocket and desk, the home and body, the street and the journey, and the worlds of money, time, and words. Along the way you'll meet forgotten inventors, stubborn myths, accidental breakthroughs, and the strange politics hiding inside the simplest things.

Every episode runs about 20 minutes, which makes it ideal for a commute, a walk, or washing the dishes (yes, we'll get to the dish soap).

Perfect for: curious minds, history lovers, trivia fans, and anyone who has ever looked at a spoon and wondered, "Who thought of this?"

And even if you've moved away from the country, you still feel right at home among the people and traditions you love. You also know there's still more you'd like to learn, experience, or pursue.
If you love swapping stories, picking up tips from people who've been there and done that, and learning about things outside your own everyday world, pull up a chair.
Welcome to Cowgirls Over Coffee, where women rooted in rural, agricultural, and Western life come together for real conversations, interesting stories, and practical wisdom worth sharing.
Join your host, Dee Ann Schnautz, as she sits down with people from all walks of life to talk about the paths they've taken, the things they've pursued, the choices they've made, what hasn't gone as planned, and what they've learned along the way.
From farming, ranching, and Western sports to family, business, community, and the unexpected turns life takes, you'll hear conversations that offer useful ideas, introduce you to possibilities you hadn't considered, remind you that other women share your experiences, and give you something worth talking about afterward.
Some episodes will leave you with a practical idea you can't wait to try. Others will make you think, "I didn't know that was possible!" or "I thought I was the only one!" And sometimes, you'll simply enjoy a really good conversation.
One conversation can spark an idea, help you see a decision differently, or give you the encouragement to take your next best step toward the life you're building—without losing sight of the people and things that matter most.
Because everyone has something worthwhile to bring to the table, and your village doesn't have to stop where you live.
Follow Cowgirls Over Coffee wherever you listen to podcasts so you never miss a conversation.
And if you'd like to keep those conversations going with women who share your interests and appreciation for this way of life, pull up a chair in our free Cowgirls Over Coffee community.

Pencil Empire uncovers the hidden stories behind money, power, business and history. From billion-dollar mistakes and financial mysteries to corporate empires, geopolitical rivalries and extraordinary historical events.
Discover the decisions, ambitions and secrets that shaped our world — one documentary at a time.

Video games are more than just entertainment - they are art, culture, and cutting-edge technology. We go beneath the surface of your favorite titles to explore game design, narrative storytelling, and the business forces shaping the gaming industry. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore enthusiast, tune in for thoughtful discussions, developer interviews, and deep dives into what makes great games tick.

title: Life Lessons with Jordan Peterson
author: William Johnson
description:
Life Lessons with Jordan Peterson explores powerful ideas about personal responsibility, discipline, purpose, psychology, relationships, and the challenges of everyday life. Discover thoughtful lessons and practical insights to help you develop a stronger mindset, make better decisions, overcome challenges, and live a more meaningful life.

Join us for conversations and reflections inspired by Jordan Peterson's ideas and teachings.

Welcome to Scary Ghost Stories, the ultimate destination for chilling tales, mysterious encounters, haunted places, and unexplained supernatural experiences.
Prepare yourself for spine-tingling stories about restless spirits, haunted houses, paranormal activities, mysterious disappearances, and terrifying encounters beyond human understanding.
From dark mysteries to unexplained events, every episode takes you deeper into a world of fear, suspense, and the unknown.
Put on your headphones, turn down the lights, and prepare for stories that will keep you listening long after midnight.

title: Soul Study

description:
Hello Everyone and welcome to soul study. 

I’m your host, Jules, a spiritual seeker by day and a Las Vegas dancer and performer by night. 

Join me in this spiritual book club style podcast where we discuss different books, stories and concepts that help us get to know ourselves and our unique individual purposes on this planet.

YouTube: SoulStudyPod

Instagram: @soulstudypodcast

title: New Punjab Foundry Store
author: New Punjab Foundry Store
description:
Foundry Store is an Indian B2B industrial supply website operated by New Punjab Foundry Store (Ferro Impex), a Ludhiana, Punjab-based business established in 1972.

The website serves as an online platform for supplying a wide range of foundry raw materials, refractory products, ferro alloys, and industrial consumables to steel, iron, and non-ferrous foundries across India.

With over five decades of industry experience, the company focuses on providing quality-assured materials, dependable supply, technical guidance, and practical product recommendations to help foundries improve their manufacturing efficiency and production processes.

Its product portfolio includes carbon raisers, ferro alloys, fire bricks, refractory castables, hard coke, core and mould chemicals, ramming mass, steel shots, foundry filters, exothermic sleeves, ceramic blankets, and other essential foundry materials.

title: Beyond Gonzo
author: Lena Rose Williams
description: Beyond Gonzo is a process interview series from Hesitation Media in Pittsburgh, hosted by Lena Rose Williams. Each episode takes one working journalist as a case study: how a story was sourced, verified, edited, and corrected, and what the record shows afterward. The show sits inside the process of journalism and the academic study of journalism. Trust in journalism keeps falling. This is an attempt to intervene by showing the work.

title: The Members Only Show, Hosted by Grafh
author: The Black Effect Podcast Network and iHeartPodcasts
description:
The Members Only Show is a hip hop talk show rooted in the essence of authentic culture. Inspired by the legendary format of Rap City, the show reimagines the classic interview-and-performance platform for a new era—blending raw conversation with the energy of live music.
 
Hosted by acclaimed New York lyricist Grafh, the series delivers in-depth, unfiltered interviews with respected rap artists who embody the integrity, craftsmanship, and codes of hip hop. Each episode transitions from dialogue to demonstration, as guests close with a live performance or freestyle backed by a full band—bringing the cypher out of the booth and onto a stage.
 
Designed to spotlight artists who represent the culture correctly, The Members Only Show is more than entertainment—it’s a platform that honors lyricism, storytelling, originality, and the spirit of true hip hop.
